description: Everything needed to interview someone for one program's enrollment form: the upcoming weeks on the form (productId, dates, pay-in-full / deposit prices, whether enrollment is open), the questions you may prefill (key, what to ask, kind, choices, required), who must fill it in, and what they still have to do on the form themselves. Read-only. Programs: sonata = The Sonatas (adult week-long camps); intermezzo = The Intermezzi (adult long weekends); capriccio = The Capriccios & Suites (adult); sonatina = Summer Sonatina (children); virtual = Virtual courses and camps.
name: get_enrollment_form
title: A program's enrollment form: upcoming weeks and the questions to ask
